end.summary:
Practised the levels of organisation: cell, tissue, organ, organ system, organism.
Gave human and plant examples, including muscle tissue and leaf as an organ.
Explained that tissues are made of cells and come before organs.
Heart-versus-circulatory-system confusion was corrected during the lesson; teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Yash practised ordering the levels and giving examples for humans and plants. They used the “small parts join to make larger levels” method and correctly distinguished the heart as one organ from the circulatory system. At home, ask them to explain the order using one human example and one plant example, then complete the sentence “A tissue is made of…”.
